feature: Add Skeleton Loading States for Better Perceived Performance
workflow_rationale: This is a UI enhancement feature that requires creating a reusable component and then applying it across multiple dashboard pages. The feature workflow allows us to properly sequence the work (create component first, then use it) and verify each step independently.

phases.name: Create Skeleton Component
phases.description: Build a reusable skeleton loading component following Tailwind CSS patterns

subtasks.description: Create skeleton component with animation and variants
implementation_notes: Use Tailwind CSS animate-pulse for shimmer effect
Create base Skeleton component with configurable dimensions
Add variants: circle, rectangle, text (multiple sizes)
Export SkeletonCard, SkeletonTable, SkeletonList composite patterns
Follow shadcn/ui component patterns with className prop support

phases.name: Apply Skeleton Loading States
phases.description: Replace spinner loading states with skeleton screens across dashboard pages

subtasks.description: Replace spinner with product list skeleton in products page

checks: Skeleton appears during loading instead of spinner
Skeleton structure matches final product list layout
No layout shift when products load

implementation_notes: Find existing spinner at lines 533-535
Import Skeleton component
Create product list skeleton matching the grid/list layout
Show 5-10 skeleton items to fill viewport
Ensure skeleton respects responsive breakpoints

subtasks.description: Replace spinner with category list skeleton in categories page
implementation_notes: Find existing loading state
Import Skeleton component
Create category skeleton matching layout
Match the card/grid structure of categories

subtasks.description: Replace spinner with dashboard skeleton in dashboard client
implementation_notes: Find existing loading state
Import Skeleton component
Create dashboard skeleton with stat cards
Match the grid layout of dashboard widgets

phases.name: Integration & Polish
phases.description: Verify all skeleton implementations work correctly and consistently

subtasks.description: End-to-end verification of skeleton loading across all pages

steps: Clear browser cache and reload app
Navigate to products page - verify skeleton appears then loads
Navigate to categories page - verify skeleton appears then loads
Navigate to dashboard - verify skeleton appears then loads
Test on slow 3G network (Chrome DevTools) - skeletons should be more visible
Verify no layout shift using Chrome DevTools Layout Shift detection
Check accessibility - skeletons should have aria-busy or aria-label

implementation_notes: Test with network throttling to see skeletons in action
Verify consistent animation timing across components
Ensure skeletons match actual content dimensions
Add aria-busy='true' and aria-label for accessibility

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution required - component must be created before use

acceptance_criteria: All existing functionality continues to work
No layout shift when content loads
Loading states provide better UX than spinners
Accessible loading states with proper ARIA labels

verification_steps.name: Visual Regression Test
verification_steps.command: Manual browser testing with network throttling
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Skeletons match content layout, smooth transitions

verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk UI enhancement. Primarily visual changes that don't affect business logic. Manual visual testing is crucial to verify skeleton layouts match actual content.

unit_tests.note: Skeleton component is presentational, visual testing more valuable than unit tests

checks: No layout shift on content load
Test with Chrome DevTools slow 3G throttling
Measure Layout Shift (CLS) - should be near 0
